by
  let m := n + 1
  let p := Nat.Prime.exists_prime_ge m (Nat.succ_pos' n)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hge⟩ := p
  use p, hp, hge
  have hkp : k ≠ 0 := hk0
  have hge_k : p ≥ k := by rw [Nat.le_add_right]; exact Nat.le_refl _
  have hlt : p < k * 1 + 1 := by rw [Nat.add_mul]; exact Nat.lt_add_right _
  have hmod_eq : p % k = p - k * (p / k) := rfl
  have hdiv : p / k = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.div_eq_zero]
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.mul_pos hkp (Nat.succ_pos' n))) hlt
  rw [hmod_eq, hdiv]
  exact Nat.sub_self k
